data_contract.censoring: TCGA-CDR observed OS; five-year administrative censoring
data_contract.likelihood: training: piecewise-constant hazard exposure likelihood using real within-interval observed time; annual discrete NLL retained for selection and reporting

selection: minimum full annual discrete NLL on fixed internal validation; outer outcomes never select model
training_sampling: patient-uniform permutation; one random observed subset and full input per patient
metrics: Harrell C; source-stratified train-fitted censoring KM IPCW Brier and cumulative/dynamic AUROC; annual-grid IBS; per-source and pooled
training_default: five fits only after source/split/real Train preflight; --execute required
label_source: fixed TCGA-CDR; CRC new labels from W082 audited comparison; original GDC run preserved
initialization: fresh model seed41+outer fold, training RNG151041+outer fold; no W159 warm start
feature_storage: existing server features shared by symlink; no feature copies or downloads
evaluation_caveat: historically reused outer folds; repeated internal evaluation, not untouched external validation
